case_desc.description: One line: the parties and what the construction dispute was about.

clauses.description: The provisions the court construed. Empty when the contract is not in the record.

clause_name.description: Short name including the section number, e.g. "Margin Maintenance para 4(a)".

taxonomy.description: Which of the risk type codes listed in the task this provision carries.

contract_id.description: The contract_id of the instrument this clause came from, exactly as tagged.

start_line.description: First line the clause occupies in that instrument.

end_line.description: Last line the clause occupies in that instrument.

text.description: The clause verbatim from those lines, with OCR damage repaired.

repairs.description: One sentence on what was repaired, or "" if nothing was.

opinion_comment_start_line.description: First line in the OPINION of the passage where the court construes this clause.

opinion_comment_end_line.description: Last line of that opinion passage.
